Brojimo od 01.01.0001. u 00:00 UTC: to j: We count from 1 January 0001 at 00:00 UTC: that is day 0. One day contains a million new seconds. For example, 739896.073.069.073 means 739896 + 73/100 + 69/10000 + 73/1000000 = 739896.736973 days.
Ovaj sat je uvek u UTC i ne menja se izb: This clock always uses UTC, regardless of your local zone selection. Its hour may therefore differ, and near midnight its day may differ too. Subtract two mathematical numbers to find the elapsed days; multiply by 86400 for conventional seconds. We follow the system Unix clock, without separately counting leap seconds. The display is truncated to six decimal places; more digits do not guarantee greater accuracy.

Dodatni dani pripadaju mesecima: 29. dan: Extra days belong to months: day 29 of the final month every year, and day 29 of the first month in leap years. Columns run from Monday to Sunday. The seven-day week continues through every month, extra day and year. Starting point: 1 January 0001 is Monday. Historical dates use the Gregorian rule extended backwards.
Nova sekunda traje 0,0864 sadašnje sekun: A new second lasts 0.0864 conventional seconds. One hundredth of a new second lasts 0.864 milliseconds.
Prvo prikazujemo sistemsko vreme uređaja: We first show your device’s system time, then the Atlas server’s time.
Kako računamo datum i vreme?: How do we calculate date and time?
The year starts on 1 January in your selected zone. Each month has 28 days, except the last, which always has 29. In leap years the first month also has 29 days. Extra days belong to their months and are numbered 029. They have ordinary weekdays too: Friday is followed by Saturday, even at the start of a new year.
Broj godine ostaje sadašnji. Pratimo gre: The year number stays the same. We use the Gregorian rule: divisible by 4, except years divisible by 100, unless also divisible by 400. This is a personal calendar for everyday life, not a measurement of Earth’s exact orbital position.
Datum 013.029 označava poslednji dan god: The date 013.029 is the final day of the year. The date 001.029 exists only in leap years and corresponds to 29 January. The annual view supports years 0001 to 9999, with the same rule for past and future.
Sat se izvodi iz vremenske oznake server: The clock is calculated from the server’s timestamp, not a count of application ticks. Hundredths are shown as fast as the screen can refresh: they are not a claim of atomic accuracy.

Šta se menja kada promenimo kalendar?: What changes when we change the calendar?
The date label changes, not the event itself. In countries that adopted the reform in 1582, Thursday 4 October in the Julian calendar was followed by Friday 15 October in the Gregorian calendar. Those people did not skip ten real days. Other countries switched later.
Tradicionalno brojanje nema godinu 0: po: Traditional numbering has no year 0: 1 BCE is followed by 1 CE. Astronomical numbering calls that same previous year 0. This does not establish the year of Jesus’s birth.
We choose one calendar for the entire input. Gregorian or Julian rules are extended into the past and future. The application does not infer the local reform date, the historical start of the year or earlier Roman irregularities. For medieval records, check the source, country and dating convention; a date already converted should not be converted again as Julian.
Tvoj kalendar zadržava pravila: prvi mes: Your calendar keeps its rules: the first month has 29 days in Gregorian leap years, the last always has 29, and the others have 28. We therefore convert through the same continuous day and Gregorian year, not just the day number within the source year.
Vreme je opciono. Bez poznatog vremena n: Time is optional. We do not assume midnight when the time is unknown. When you enter it, we convert only the units within the same time basis; we do not calculate historical local zones, changes to day boundaries, sidereal time or Earth’s position.

Zelena, široka, trougao. Oznaka 5 znači: Green, broad, triangle tip. Mark 5 means 50 hours; the seventh small tick after it means 57.

Brojčanik ima deset glavnih oznaka i sto: The dial has ten major marks and one hundred small divisions. Each major mark means ten units: 5 = 50 hours, minutes or seconds. Small divisions show individual units, so separate hands for them are unnecessary. At 57 hours, 24 minutes and 12 seconds, the green hand is just past division 57, gold just past 24, and red at 12. All three sweep smoothly, like a conventional clock. The hour hand takes 24 conventional hours per revolution, the minute hand 14 minutes and 24 seconds, and the second hand 8.64 seconds. Smaller time units determine positions between the divisions.
